annotation.title_clean: Education – Artificial Intelligence – Guidelines, Professional Development, and Workgroup (Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act) (Senate Bill 720)
annotation.title_en: Education – Artificial Intelligence – Guidelines, Professional Development, and Workgroup (Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act) (Senate Bill 720)
annotation.summary_en: Maryland's enacted Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (SB 720, 2026) requires the State Department of Education to issue AI guidance, rubrics for evaluating AI tools and teacher professional development. It requires local school AI policies and coordinators, and it creates the Maryland AI Education Collaborative. The Act concerns software AI in K–12 schools, not robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Department of Education must publish AI guidance for school systems, educators, parents and students and review it yearly.
Each local school system must adopt an AI policy within 120 days of the guidance and designate an AI coordinator.
Department must publish a rubric for evaluating AI tools; Morgan State or another university supports certification; procurement must follow State procurement law.
AI literacy is to be part of workforce preparation standards by June 1, 2027, with statewide train-the-trainer professional development.
Creates the Maryland AI Education Collaborative, which reports annually from December 2027; its section is abrogated after May 31, 2028.
